A provincial-level legislature in this state/province certified and affirmed a 2023 municipal ordinance protecting the rights of LGBTQI persons in one of its municipalities (a council resolution of 19 August 2024) — a provincial-level endorsement of a municipal LGBTQ+ protection ordinance in an otherwise conservative area. It gives a visitor in this state/province a local complaint route that most of the country lacks.

Against that, two constituent jurisdictions within this state/province host a codified indigenous customary-justice system with its own dispute-resolution authority over “crimes and tribal-related offences,” recognised by the country's national courts. No trans-specific customary ruling or exclusion was documented, but the legal-pluralism structure means that in a rural dispute in those jurisdictions the applicable institution may not be a national court.
